per_depth.shortcut_name: Steiner-tree connectivity with optional intermediate currencies
per_depth.common_affordance: The task is a minimum-cost Steiner tree: all anchors must be connected, and non-anchor vertices may be shared intermediate vertices.
The requirement is connectivity of all primary ledgers, with paths allowed to share edges and pass through non-primary nodes.
The statement explicitly permits non-target vertices to serve as shared intermediates, exposing the problem as a Steiner-tree problem in the graph of difference vectors.
The joint kernel condition is exactly equivalent to requiring the selected functional edges to connect all critical indices, i.e. a weighted Steiner-tree problem.
The covector-span condition is equivalent to connectivity of the essential indices in an undirected weighted graph, yielding a Steiner-tree subset DP.
The orthogonality condition on incidence vectors is exactly a minimum-cost weighted Steiner-tree problem connecting all target coordinates.
